verdict.rationale: Plausible documents a read-only Stats API for historical and real-time stats. Its /api/v2/query endpoint accepts simple and complex queries via POST and returns JSON, with team-scoped API keys, so an agent could programmatically pull growth metrics. Nothing in the evidence shows an MCP server or other agent-oriented affordances, and probes found no llms.txt, no markdown docs and no OpenAPI spec, which makes agent integration a custom build. Missing for 10: an official MCP server, a machine-readable API spec for agent tool generation, agent/LLM-oriented docs, SQL/warehouse-style query access, and hands-on corroboration of agents using the API.
